parsed.explanation: Thin-data jurisdiction; extrapolate from structural signals. No trans-specific criminal offence, no traveler-facing restrictions (no facility bans, border friction, or police targeting documented), and no record of the pending 2017 bills advancing — that advocacy bill is resident-facing and latent, a tangential signal only. But the positive side is thin: no LGR, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, and the judiciary documented as non-protective, so if outed a visitor has no remedy. The climate evidence — a 2018 official finding of hostility toward visibly LGBTI people, concentrated in the capital, and the unsolved 2019 death of the national LGBTQ advocacy president — is dated and single-incident; it shows social hostility (tier 3) toward visible gender nonconformity rather than organised or state targeting. Camp harassment after the 2010 earthquake is dated, no prevalence. No evidence of current anti-trans violence rates either way. Per the rubric's thin-data rule: latent tangential statute plus open questions plus thin formal recourse sits a step below the acceptance-with-protections tier, and documented social hostility with no recourse prevents a Reduced-band high score. 0.55.
